theorems.name: Submission.bf_plane_closedBall_measure_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (W : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)), finrank ℝ W = n → μHE[n] ((W : Set (Rn N)) ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 1) < ∞ ∧ ∀ y ∈ W, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 ≤ ρ → μHE[n] ((W : Set (Rn N)) ∩ Metric.closedBall y ρ) = ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n) * μHE[n] ((W : Set (Rn N)) ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 1)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
